name: dart-safe-data-class-shodev
description: Immutable Dart data classes without code generation — toMap/fromMap, copyWith, equality, hashCode, sealed types. Analyzer-clean under strict-casts.

dart-data-class-generator.custom.argumen.description: The error that is thrown on `cast<T>()` invalid argument. Use `k` for key, `map[k]` for value and T for argument Type.

default: // Generated by Datly. * Change this header in extension settings *
dart-data-class-generator.custom.headerL.description: Custom header lines to be added at the top of the generated file.

dart-data-class-generator.custom.types.description: Custom directives for specific types. Define each type with `type` for the type name, `fromMap` for the fromMap function, and `toMap` for the toMap function.

fromMap.description: How to convert in fromMap. Ex: DateTime.parse(String)

toMap.description: How to convert in toMap. Ex: toIso8601String()

dart-data-class-generator.json.enum_form.description: Whether to use parse using Enum.values.byName or Enum.values[index].

dart-data-class-generator.json.key_forma.description: Whether to use snake_case or camelCase for the json keys.

dart-data-class-generator.json.separate.description: Whether to separate a JSON into multiple files, when the JSON contains nested objects. ask: choose manually every time, separate: always separate into multiple files, current_file: always insert all classes into the current file.

dart-data-class-generator.strict_numbers.description: If true, `int` and `double` will use isA<int>(...) instead of isA<num>(...).toInt() syntax.

dart-data-class-generator.quick_fixes.description: If true, enables quick fixes to quickly generate data classes or specific methods only.

dart-data-class-generator.fromMap.defaul.description: If true, checks if a field is null when deserializing and provides a non-null default value.

dart-data-class-generator.constructor.de.description: If true, generates default values for the constructor.

dart-data-class-generator.constructor.im.description: If true, adds @immutable annotation on the generated class. Note: This forces all fields to be final, and all constructor to be const.

dart-data-class-generator.override.manua.description: If true, asks, when overriding a class (running the command on an existing class), for every single function/constructor that needs to be changed whether the generator should override the function or not. This allows you to preserve custom changes you made to the function/constructor that would be otherwise overwritten by the generator.

dart-data-class-generator.constructor.en.description: If true, generates a constructor for a data class.

dart-data-class-generator.copyWith.enabl.description: If true, generates a copyWith function for a data class.

dart-data-class-generator.toMap.enabled.description: If true, generates a toMap function for a data class.

dart-data-class-generator.fromMap.enable.description: If true, generates a fromMap function for a data class.

dart-data-class-generator.toJson.enabled.description: If true, generates a toJson function for a data class.

dart-data-class-generator.fromJson.enabl.description: If true, generates a fromJson function for a data class.

dart-data-class-generator.toString.enabl.description: If true, generates a toString function for a data class.

dart-data-class-generator.equality.enabl.description: If true, generates an override of the == (equals) operator for a data class.

dart-data-class-generator.hashCode.enabl.description: If true, generates a hashCode function for a data class.

dart-data-class-generator.hashCode.use_j.description: If true, uses the Jenkins SMI hash function instead of bitwise operator from dart:ui.

dart-data-class-generator.useEquatable.description: If true, uses equatable for value equality and hashcode.

dart-data-class-generator.toMap.defensiv.description: If true, wraps collections in List.unmodifiable/Map.unmodifiable in toMap to prevent external mutation.

dart-data-class-generator.formatting.tra.description: If true, adds trailing commas after the last parameter in generated code (Dart style guide recommended).

dart-data-class-generator.copyWith.requi.description: If true, generates copyWith with all required parameters (forces explicit value passing).

dart-data-class-generator.sealed.enabled.description: If true, auto-generates Success/Failure subclasses for sealed Result types.
